title: Grilled Tofu, Bell Pepper & Zucchini Tacos with Spicy Apricot Sauce

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve apricots lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Small dice the flesh and place in a medium saucepan.

Add sugar, vinegar, soy sauce, salt, and crushed red pepper to the pan with the apricots. Set pan over medium-low heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until apricots are soft and juicy, 10-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, slice tofu into 2-inch wide planks. Season with spices on both sides.
Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; add the tofu and cook until golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm. (Reserve pan for later use.)
While the tofu is cooking, trim and slice zucchini lengthwise into ¼-inch thick planks. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and quarter bell peppers; add to the bowl with the zucchini. Drizzle with oil, season with spices, and toss to combine.
Return pan to medium-high heat. Working in batches if necessary, add veggies and cook, turning occasionally, until charred and fork-tender, about 5 minutes. Add to the plate with the tofu.
When the apricots are done, remove from heat. Use a potato masher to mash and combine a semi-smooth sauce. Set aside.
Transfer grilled tofu and veggies to the cutting board and roughly chop into bite-sized pieces.
Warm tortillas in the grill pan, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates, fill with grilled tofu and veggies, then top with apricot sauce. Enjoy!
